text: Android: rename SyncWorker to TuppuSyncWorker so its log lines read as the app's own, and replace the enqueued periodic job on upgrade

On main (6c12500e), full gate green: TuppuSyncWorker (log tag likewise); the periodic job uses ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE, so a request stored under the old class name is replaced in place on the next app start (real-WorkManager test; skipped only on aarch64).
